hypotheses.title: Inherited operational memory layer for repeat/near-repeat web tasks
hypotheses.user_problem: Browser agents re-pay full exploration cost (actions, model calls, tokens, latency) on repeat or near-repeat tasks already solved before.
validated_building_blocks: cumulative store + provenance/confidence fields + exact replay + entry-state reset (Graph G-H1)
blind content-addressed fragment retrieval with expected-UNKNOWN discipline (Graph G-H2)
oracle-equalized iterative replay policy carrying composed depth (Graph G-H2/G-H3 E2)
multi-step login procedure packaging as first-class reusable unit (Graph G-H3 E2, G-H4 R3)
V31 closed-class descriptor/query equipment (Graph G-H4) — adopted as equipment only
unvalidated_assumptions: inheritance survives a real LLM consumer (all accepted evidence is scripted deterministic consumers)
free-form natural-language goals work end-to-end without hand-authored goal signatures at product level
savings are material in tokens/model-calls/wall-clock with an LLM in the loop
known failure modes (category goals, >3 distinct fragments, cross-site transfer) stay contained in declared scope
hypotheses.expected_operational_benefit: On repeat/near-repeat tasks: large reductions in browser actions, model calls/tokens and latency at non-inferior success; reused-action share dominates the action mix.
hypotheses.differentiation: Subgoal-addressable executable fragments with empirical validation statistics, provenance and freshness metadata consumed by an external model-agnostic layer — bounded hypothesis from audit-qualified Run-1 survey, not a novelty claim.
hypotheses.conceptual_architecture: Producer runs grow validated store -> V31-canonicalized content-addressed retrieval selects fragments/procedures for subgoals -> consumer LLM executes memory-led with exploration fallback and explicit UNKNOWN reporting -> anchored completion predicate equalized across arms -> outcomes written back with provenance (calibration deferred).
hypotheses.biggest_uncertainty: Whether the scripted-setup advantage survives a real LLM consumer without memory-induced wrong actions or stale-fragment traps.
hypotheses.evidence_needed: Beta PB-001 outcome vs cold-agent and trajectory-RAG baselines under the preregistered win rule.

hypotheses.title: Shared capability infrastructure line (Steam-like registry)
hypotheses.user_problem: Many agents/teams independently re-explore the same sites; shared reusable capability infrastructure could amortize exploration.
hypotheses.why_watch: Intel ledger empty (zero reproduced+audited mechanisms); internal confidence/staleness uncalibrated (G8/G9 open); cross-model consumption untested (G10 open). Excluded from PB-001.
hypotheses.path_to_promising: First audited Intel mechanism reproducing in a SPIDER-relevant test; G8/G9 calibration evidence; any cross-model consumption result.

hypotheses.title: Predictive Web-dynamics routing (physics-powered navigation)
hypotheses.reason: Physics WP-003B-R2 FALSIFIED (mean D -0.5016, 0/5 folds, site holdout) and WP-005 FALSIFIED (T1 wins 1/9 p=0.898; T2 wins 4/9 p=0.270), both independently audited; predictability decomposes into persistence + site-local NN memory + action-type semantics. WP-004 committor work blocked pending identifiability. A genuinely new instrument producing an audited positive would be required to reopen narrowly.

hypotheses.title: Selector self-healing / staleness product
hypotheses.user_problem: Agents break on site drift; selectors need repair/revalidation.
hypotheses.spider_angle: Store-level failure events + provenance + freshness could drive revalidation and localized re-exploration instead of silent failure (entry-reset audited as recovery POC only).
hypotheses.why_watch: Staleness/confidence uncalibrated; no audited repair-value result over retry/TTL heuristics; Healenium-adjacent competitor space is established.
